== Summary ==
[[Casey Anis]] (8th place) with his crystal award in front of the Players Committee banner. Taken at the [[2021 World Championship]] (the Hyatt Regency Crystal City, Arlington, Virginia, 8–10 October 2021).

'''Identification:''' Identified by matching his face (receding hairline, features, smile) to his place in [[:File:2021 World Championship Top 8.jpg]] (front row, left; wrap-up caption); clothing differs (red Maryland Football T-shirt).

* '''Event:''' [[2021 World Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2021-10-31
